paragraphs.label: Mở thư và mục đích
paragraphs.text:
Dear Ms Brown,

Thank you for your enquiry about a neighbourhood walking event. I am writing to provide the information you requested. I hope the following details will help you make the necessary arrangements.

Thank you for your enquiry about [sự kiện / hoạt động]. I am writing to provide the information you requested. I hope the following details will help you make the necessary arrangements.

paragraphs.label: Thông tin thứ nhất
paragraphs.text: First of all, the event will take place at the park entrance on Saturday at nine in the morning. Participants will have the opportunity to explore a short local route and note useful improvements. The programme is intended to provide a practical introduction to walking as a daily habit.
